comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
NPC Location: San Francisco, near shipyard
Found only on certain days of the NA event cycle.

Contents: War Axe x1, Bamboo broom, LCCT x5, Exquisite Fur x1, Cranberry juice (+20 vig) x50, 3* Large Ship Blueprints x1, +30% speed boost 1h x1, Veil of Dominions (1hr) x1, PO1 x10, PO2 x10, PO3 x10, PO4 x10

War Axe is memorial album entry for the "Rare Items Traveled by Train" MA (new MA that gives Dragoon Revolver, 60att handgun +2 gunfire +2 sniping +2 arms)
